DiffField.description:
The compared measure a :class:`Difference` is about.

One member per row of ``docs/contracts/stats-definition.md`` "비교 임계",
plus ``bucket`` for a ``(space, layer)`` bucket that exists on one side
only (always ``RED``: a missing bucket is never a tolerance question).
DiffField.title: DiffField

Difference.description: One measured disagreement inside one bucket.

absolute_delta.description: Largest absolute corner delta in mm for `bbox`; null otherwise.
absolute_delta.title: Absolute Delta

detail.description: Human-readable cause, e.g. `count_by_type.LINE 24→22`. Rendered verbatim into the markdown report.
detail.title: Detail

entity_types.description: DXF record names present in this bucket (union of both sides, plus ATTRIB when the bucket's text_count exceeds its TEXT+MTEXT count). This is what a whitelist entry's `entity_type` matches against.
entity_types.title: Entity Types

other_value.description: The other document's value, as text.
other_value.title: Other Value

reference_value.description: The reference document's value, as text.
reference_value.title: Reference Value

relative_delta.description: |a-b| / max(|a|,|b|) for the numeric measures; null otherwise.
relative_delta.title: Relative Delta

severity.description: RED unless a whitelist entry explains it.

whitelist_id.description: Id of the whitelist entry that downgraded this difference (e.g. `W03`).
whitelist_id.title: Whitelist Id

whitelist_reason.description: Reason quoted from the whitelist entry that downgraded this to AMBER.
whitelist_reason.title: Whitelist Reason

Difference.title: Difference

layer.description: Layer name, or `(totals)` for the document totals row.
layer.title: Layer

space.description: `MODEL` or `PAPER:<layout>`, or `(all)` for the totals row.
space.title: Space

description:
Full comparison of two ``LayerStatsDocument``s.

Stored as-is on ``drawing_file.parser_crosscheck``.

amber_layers.description: Sorted layer names whose worst difference is AMBER.
amber_layers.title: Amber Layers

file_sha256.description: sha256 the two documents agree on, or null when they disagree.
file_sha256.title: File Sha256

file_sha256_mismatch.description: True when the two documents were computed from different bytes (DWG vs. its DXF conversion). Never fatal on its own — the comparison still runs (brief W2-04, Defaults for ambiguity).
file_sha256_mismatch.title: File Sha256 Mismatch

layers.description: One entry per bucket, ordered by (layer, space).
layers.title: Layers

red_layers.description: Sorted, deduplicated layer names carrying at least one RED difference. Confidence routing input (ADR-0002 6: 적색 레이어에 근거를 둔 항목은 신뢰도를 감점한다).
red_layers.title: Red Layers

schema_version.description: Version of this report shape, not of the inputs.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

status.description: Worst status across every layer and the totals row.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notes, e.g. the sha256 mismatch.
warnings.title: Warnings

whitelist_path.description: Whitelist file used, if any (as given on the command line).
whitelist_path.title: Whitelist Path

title: CrosscheckReport
